objective.teacher_input_from_pixel_variable: normalize RGB [0,1] using Aircraft Teacher mean/std immediately before Teacher forward
objective.classification: mean ground-truth cross entropy over the actual 100-image construction batch
objective.bn: sum over BatchNorm2d input statistics of w_l*(non-squared channel-vector L2(batch_mean-running_mean)+non-squared channel-vector L2(batch_variance-running_variance))

pixel_optimization.batches: one rank slot at a time; one image per class; three independent Adam states
pixel_optimization.augmentation: independent per-image HorizontalFlip(p=0.5), paired across arms
pixel_optimization.protection_gradient_coordinates: the flip backward maps gradients to original image coordinates; apply the original unflipped mask exactly once to the RGB parameter gradient
pixel_optimization.export: lossless RGB PNG quantized by round(255*x)
pixel_optimization.gradient_component_audit: CE and weighted-BN gradients from one forward and identical flips via autograd.grad; these calls do not populate .grad; exactly one total-loss backward supplies the optimizer gradient
pixel_optimization.pixel_change_audit: at audit updates record post-projection single-step displacement and cumulative displacement from R0; separately record editable-coordinate L-infinity-bound hits and RGB 0/1 boundary hits

arms.cam_protected: top 15053 initial CAM pixels restored exactly after every update
arms.random_protected: same CAM mask circularly shifted by a stable per-image 2D offset; stable-hash redraw with a counter until nonzero

cam.definition: ReLU(sum_k fc_weight[y,k]*layer4_feature[k]) on the initial unflipped R0 image, bilinear upsampled from 7x7 to 224x224
cam.random_control_note: circular shift preserves mask area exactly but wraparound may split connected components in planar coordinates; shifts are not selected by overlap

downstream.fkd: standard-v2 fullframe+flip+CutMix metadata replay; ResNet Teacher42 train-mode BSSL relabeling of exported pixels
downstream.student: standard protocol v2 ImageNet-V1 ResNet18, T20 KL without T^2, three student seeds 42/43/44
